

![What is Lemmatization in NLP?](data:image/png;base64,)

A lemmatizer is an [NLP tool](https://www.engati.com/glossary/lemmatization) that reduces inflected words to their dictionary base form (lemma) using vocabulary and morphological analysis. Unlike stemming, it considers context and part-of-speech (e.g., "better" becomes "good," "running" becomes "run") to ensure accuracy. Common implementations include NLTK’s WordNetLemmatizertizer and spaCy’s Lemmatize
